digest.component_or_area: plan review verdict dispatch and criteria assembly
propositions: A CriteriaError raised during deterministic assemble-criteria step is misclassified as an LLM outage and stamped with llm_unavailable=true in the plan review verdict
The generic workflow interpreter records typed exceptions only as undifferentiated strings, causing source-blind degradation routing that treats all unrecovered failures as LLM failures

Stale or malformed project criteria configurations must emit a fail-closed INDETERMINATE verdict with a distinct config-fault marker and actionable installed-build diagnostic, not an llm_unavailable flag

The verdict dispatch must inspect the recorded assemble step's failure kind and route structured CriteriaError failures to a dedicated config-fault path before generic LLM degradation, preserving deterministic findings and DET tier coverage
